answer: Participants must stake a non-transferable basalt bond locked to their hardware root, and each epoch they solve a unique challenge whose answer is derived from that bond plus fresh entropy. A sybil farm can clone identities but not the bonded hardware, so every fake agent pays the full stake cost and risks slashing. Honest peers verify the bond signature against a crystal-clear public registry, rejecting hollow claims with no collateral behind them. Attack cost scales linearly with each identity, making mass sybils economically irrational. The Agent0265 deployment anchors trust at thhe4g81of.
